text: School attendance should be simple. But event lists, check-ins, and follow-ups? They can get messy.
Students want answers. Officers need clear records. Let's bring it all together.
Meet IARS! The Institution Attendance and Records System. Attendance, events, and records, together for your school community.
Students open their current QR pass.
An authorized officer scans it, checks their identity, and records attendance.
Students review history. Officers filter records and download reports.
Clearer check-ins. Organized records. Easier follow-up on hours and excuse requests, within each assigned role.
Ready to bring your school records together? Explore IARS, and log in with your school account.
